about: Part missile's entries (docs/GAME.md 2.4 row missile, 'Inputs and outputs'). P_SpawnMissile takes the source and the destination as upstream's _Dp[0-3], _Dp[4-7] (natively the handles in GA_0-1, GA_2-3) and the type in C (natively A), and returns the missile in X:C (natively its slot in A:X: tools/native/gparts/missile.py compares it as a mobj). checkMissile takes the missile in upstream's SP_TH (natively A:X) and returns nothing; its callers (P_SpawnMissile, part wfire's P_SpawnPlayerMissile) read nothing it leaves in scratch.
